policy: Use supported extension seams first; preserve upstream protection hooks. Each extension requires implementation and acceptance evidence before activation. All commands enforce relevant core extensions regardless of entry path.

extensions.purpose: Business, branch and role isolation for every generated and custom collection, query, export, webhook mapping and command.
extensions.delivery: NEXG identity bridge plus scoped access rules; resource-owner mode alone is insufficient.
extensions.acceptance: Cross-business and unauthorized staff operations fail on every route, including Local API and background processing.

extensions.purpose: Guarded idempotent booking commands, atomic allocation, expected revisions, trusted hold expiry and durable operation lookup.
extensions.delivery: NEXG command adapter over Payload transactions and locks; close unguarded collection CRUD and verify every adapter path.
extensions.acceptance: Final-place/overlap races, multi-resource failure, retry and timeout recover to one authoritative result.

extensions.purpose: Per-offering work lifecycle, intake, cancellation and payment requirements alongside a common reservation lifecycle.
extensions.delivery: Versioned NEXG policy and permitted transitions; do not configure 128 global plugin status machines.
extensions.acceptance: Only allowed transitions occur; staff/admin/background paths obey the same relevant policy; failed reschedule preserves original.

extensions.purpose: Fixed Africa/Nairobi display, input, recurrence and business date interpretation.
extensions.delivery: Enforced platform/tenant defaults, UTC timed storage and separate local dates; no merchant timezone question.
extensions.acceptance: Overnight, 00:30, multi-day and Google-offset imports preserve Kenyan local meaning.

extensions.purpose: Optional separate merchant-owned Google calendar, scoped consent, busy-time policy, identity mapping and reconciliation.
extensions.delivery: NEXG OAuth and sync adapter; plugin external-busy hook alone is not integration.
extensions.acceptance: No personal disclosure, duplicate sync or loop; revocation/outage remains visible; event deletion does not bypass booking cancellation policy.

extensions.purpose: Per-data-class external reservation authority, real capability mapping, freshness and safe source transitions.
extensions.delivery: Versioned provider adapters and operation references, including quantity-aware external allocations; missing authoritative input stays unknown.
extensions.acceptance: External requests remain pending until confirmed; timeout/duplicates/reconnect reconcile; source migration avoids two independent writers.

extensions.purpose: Configured KES price/deposit/collection/refund behavior with consent, minor-unit amounts and separate financial state.
extensions.delivery: Adapter to supported payment owner/rail; deduplicated callbacks, late-payment recovery and versioned price/policy snapshots.
extensions.acceptance: Callback before/after hold expiry and duplicate refund cannot double-confirm, double-charge or steal a later reservation.

extensions.purpose: Post-commit notifications, reminders, provider tasks and observability.
extensions.delivery: Transactional durable tasks, idempotent workers, bounded retries, failure visibility and reconciliation.
extensions.acceptance: Rollback sends no confirmation; retries do not duplicate messages; lost/reordered provider updates recover.

extensions.purpose: Exact long asset/occupancy/itinerary intervals and a multi-day portal timeline.
extensions.delivery: Bounded plugin flexible ceiling plus stricter per-offering limits, half-open ranges, turnaround and renewal validation.
extensions.acceptance: Interval extension checks conflicts and preserves old booking on failure; full-day 23:59:59 semantics are not substituted for multi-day promises.

extensions.purpose: Dated occurrences, shared place pools, ticket types, series exceptions, passes and check-in.
extensions.delivery: Session/ticket collections plus atomic compatible allocations; reserve instructor/venue once per occurrence while attendees share its capacity.
extensions.acceptance: Final-place race, ticket-class shared cap, same-session instructor sharing and per-occurrence cancellation remain correct.

extensions.purpose: Travel-aware visits, transfer/greeter variants, coverage, access and dispatch milestones.
extensions.delivery: NEXG fulfilment/location/resource logic with explicit travel and waiting policies, joint eligible resource allocation.
extensions.acceptance: Out-of-area or unavailable linked resource prevents confirmation without orphan hold; changing flight time proposes a controlled change.

extensions.purpose: Party-size-compatible table/space selection, combinations and turnover.
extensions.delivery: Table/space inventory and party policy; explicit offers_table_reservations separate from existing-system discovery.
extensions.acceptance: Combined tables reserve together; total seated capacity or declared external system never alone enables a table promise.

extensions.purpose: Specifications, approval, production workload and due promises.
extensions.delivery: Typed production capacity and due-date workflow; use compatible reservation primitives only for actual time allocations.
extensions.acceptance: Too-short lead time or overloaded due window is rejected; sourcing versus manufacture and linked fitting/delivery stay distinct.

extensions.purpose: Paired collection/dropoff, processing and return feasibility.
extensions.delivery: Linked schedule/processing commitments with a shared operation identity and optional transport children.
extensions.acceptance: Infeasible return blocks the whole promise; customer dropoff does not create a rider task; retries cannot duplicate either leg.

extensions.purpose: Queue, intake, assessment, approval, technician/bay work and handoff.
extensions.delivery: NEXG service job lifecycle; appointments reserve only explicitly scheduled intake/work intervals.
extensions.acceptance: Walk-in and scheduled work share resources; completion estimate differs from appointment start; assessment consent is retained.

extensions.purpose: Membership/retainer scope, credits, validity and optional authorized renewals.
extensions.delivery: Entitlement ledger linked to actual bookings; recurrence/fulfilment repeats remain separate concepts.
extensions.acceptance: Plan alone occupies no slots; credit and reservation retry safely; expired plan cannot authorize restricted service.

extensions.purpose: Cargo dimensions/units, quotes, carrier authority, controlled capacity and shipment legs.
extensions.delivery: Typed freight collections and transactional capacity allocation within the booking runtime when NEXG controls it; carrier adapter otherwise.
extensions.acceptance: Weight and volume both checked without guest-count substitution; carrier pending is visible; no fictional shipment milestones.

extensions.purpose: Typed storage unit/area/volume occupancy over an interval with handling visits separate.
extensions.delivery: Storage inventory, explicit unit/precision and interval-capacity ledger under the same reservation transaction.
extensions.acceptance: Full-interval capacity is enforced, implicit area conversion rejected and access visits do not double-count occupancy.

extensions.purpose: Scope, response ownership, approval and provider-confirmed commitment after request.
extensions.delivery: NEXG request/quote state separate from blocking reservation state; accepted work binds a supported resource model once.
extensions.acceptance: Request has no hold by default; duplicate acceptance creates one child; supplier-dependent confirmation waits for authority.

extensions.purpose: NEXG merchant and customer interfaces, accessible agenda/actions, specialized timelines and eight-screen contracts.
extensions.delivery: Reuse Payload components/primitives only through a compatible boundary, otherwise NEXG components using the booking API; no automatic second calendar library.
extensions.acceptance: Appropriate model view, mobile/non-drag/keyboard use, correct personal/business scope, useful empty/error/pending states.

extensions.purpose: Onboarding/offerings resolver, typed question applicability, preview, immutable revisions and future-category publication.
extensions.delivery: Approved category manifest binds the existing bounded predicate language to these models and declared questions; no executable category scripts or permission grants.
extensions.acceptance: Every current subcategory resolves or shows precise incomplete setup; new supported category reuses components and unfamiliar operations remain inactive.
